resources.title: Principles for Responsible Management Education (PRME) & SIP reporting
resources.summary: Seven principles signed by 650+ business and management schools, with a biennial Sharing Information on Progress report. Developed in 2007 by a task force convened by the UN Global Compact with the main management-education bodies.

resources.title: Sulitest: sustainability literacy test (TASK™)
resources.summary: Online assessment of sustainability knowledge used by universities and organisations worldwide; born from the UN Higher Education Sustainability Initiative after Rio+20 and promoted by PRME.

resources.title: Climate Fresk (La Fresque du Climat) workshop
resources.summary: Three-hour collaborative workshop on the science of climate change (IPCC-based), delivered by trained facilitators in schools, universities and companies; widely used in French business-school curricula.

resources.title: AACSB Business Accreditation Standards (2020), incl. societal impact
resources.summary: Accreditation standards for 1,000+ business schools; the 2020 revision makes positive societal impact an explicit expectation. GRLI is held in strategic partnership with AACSB, EFMD and oikos.

resources.title: EFMD EQUIS accreditation & BSIS (Business School Impact System)
resources.summary: EQUIS accredits whole business schools with an ethics, responsibility and sustainability chapter; BSIS, created by FNEGE and developed with EFMD, measures a school’s impact on its territory.

resources.title: AMBA & BGA accreditation
resources.summary: Programme-level accreditation of MBA, DBA and master’s degrees, plus the Business Graduates Association charter on responsible management and impact.

resources.title: Positive Impact Rating for business schools
resources.summary: The first rating of business schools conducted by their own students, measuring perceived societal impact; launched with the support of oikos International and GRLI among others.

resources.title: RRBM: A Vision of Responsible Research in Business and Management
resources.summary: Position paper and network calling for credible and useful research; endorsed and co-sponsored by the main accreditation and school networks.

resources.title: The 50+20 Agenda: Management Education for the World
resources.summary: Vision for management education presented at Rio+20, co-produced by GRLI, PRME and the World Business School Council for Sustainable Business; foundation of the “business schools for the world” narrative.

resources.title: Giving Voice to Values curriculum
resources.summary: Values-driven leadership curriculum (cases, exercises, pedagogy) created with the Aspen Institute and Yale SOM, now hosted at Babson College and used in 1,000+ schools and companies.

resources.title: GMAT exam
resources.summary: Standardised admission test owned by GMAC, used by 7,000+ graduate business programmes; a lever on who enters management education.

resources.title: SDG Academy free online courses
resources.summary: Free MOOCs and teaching materials on sustainable development, produced by the SDG Academy, the education arm of the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network.

resources.title: HESI Communities of Practice & Partnership Framework
resources.summary: UN-backed partnership of 1,300+ universities, networks and UN entities; thematic communities of practice launched at the 2025 HESI Global Forum, chaired with UN DESA, UN University, UNESCO-IESALC and Sulitest.

resources.title: Earth for All: a survival guide for humanity (report to the Club of Rome)
resources.summary: Modelling-based report proposing five extraordinary turnarounds, convened by the Club of Rome with the Potsdam Institute, Stockholm Resilience Centre and BI Norwegian Business School; basis of policy and teaching material.

resources.title: NBS evidence-based guides & research-centre community
resources.summary: Peer-reviewed, practice-oriented syntheses for business leaders, and a community of 170+ sustainability research centres in business schools.

resources.title: THE Impact Rankings (universities against the SDGs)
resources.summary: Global ranking assessing 2,000+ universities on research, stewardship, outreach and teaching towards the 17 SDGs.

resources.title: SDG Accord: the university and college sector’s collective response to the SDGs
resources.summary: Commitment signed by institutions and networks to embed the SDGs and report annually; developed and led by EAUC with sector partners and the UN HESI.

resources.title: AASHE STARS: Sustainability Tracking, Assessment & Rating System
resources.summary: Self-reporting framework used by 1,000+ colleges and universities to measure sustainability performance across academics, engagement, operations and administration.

resources.title: Business Schools for Climate Leadership toolkit
resources.summary: Open toolkit for business leaders on climate action, co-authored by eight European business schools (Cambridge Judge, HEC Paris, IE, IESE, INSEAD, LBS, Oxford Saïd, IMD).

resources.title: Impact Management Platform: shared vocabulary of impact management
resources.summary: Collaboration of standard-setters (UNEP FI, UN Global Compact, WBCSD, B Lab, GRI, OECD, IFRS…) clarifying the actions of impact management and how their standards fit together.

resources.title: B Impact Assessment & B Corp certification
resources.summary: Free assessment of a company’s social and environmental performance, basis of B Corp certification (9,000+ companies); used as a teaching case and student challenge in business schools.

resources.title: Caux Round Table Principles for Business
resources.summary: Early stakeholder-based ethical principles for business, revised in 2009, with a self-assessment process (Arcturus).

resources.title: Globethics open-access library & Consortium on Ethics in Higher Education
resources.summary: Multilingual digital library on ethics, accredited online courses and a consortium of universities working on ethics in higher education.

resources.title: Economics of Mutuality operating model, cases & curricula
resources.summary: Impact-led management model developed in a Mars–Saïd Business School programme, with teaching curricula and case studies now carried by the EoM Alliance.

resources.title: 2tonnes workshop
resources.summary: Three-hour simulation workshop in which participants build a path to a 2-tonne carbon footprint by 2050, used in schools and companies.

resources.title: Global Peter Drucker Forum (Vienna)
resources.summary: Annual management conference gathering academics, executives and students around Drucker’s humanistic management thinking.

resources.title: Prototype: Responsible ecosystem management
resources.summary: Light coordination structure for business-education networks and standards bodies, led by the GRLI Foundation as one of the initiative’s first prototypes.

resources.title: Prototype: Humanistic Leadership Academy
resources.summary: Four-stage programme for applying humanistic leadership, led by the International Humanistic Management Association.

resources.title: Prototype: Student voice
resources.summary: Integrates students’ experiences and aspirations into business education, led by HE4G, the Club of Rome and oikos International.

resources.title: Prototype: Business schools for thriving cities
resources.summary: Research programme on how business schools can support their host cities, led by the Global Business School Network.

resources.title: Prototype: Awareness-based systems transformation journey
resources.summary: Four-session programme for educators based on Theory U, led by the Presencing Institute.

resources.title: Prototype: CEC academic roadmap
resources.summary: Joint roadmap to transform curricula and institutions, starting in France then across Europe, led by the Convention des Entreprises pour le Climat.
